I. O. REG
No. 226
Date 4/4/16...

Shanghai Municipal Council.

April 4th 1916

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)

Sir,
It is reported that the rebels held a meeting
at No.32 Admiral Bayle on the evening of 3rd instant
when they decided to remain quiescent for the present.
The Chapel Military Authorities had field guns
posted at strategic points last night.
It is reported that the 13th Regiment which is
stationed in Woosung and Chapei is under orders to
start for Canton. This regiment is 1,200 strong.
It is reported that General Yang visited
Nanking yesterday for the purpose of consulting with
Chiangchun Feng with a view to declaring independence.
It is reported that nine men of the 38th regiment
at the Arsenal were shot on 3rd instant for disclosing
military secrets to the rebels.

Your Obedient Servant,

（签名）
Chief Detective Inspector.

（签名）
Captain Superintendent of Police.

I. O. REG
第 226 号
日期 1916年4月4日...

上海工部局。

1916年4月4日

（印：上海工部局）
警务处，
（侦探科。）

先生：

据报，叛军于本月3日晚在百乐路32号举行会议，会上决定暂时保持静默。

法租界军事当局昨晚已在各战略要地部署野战炮。

据报，驻防吴淞和闸北的第13团已奉命开赴广东。该团兵力为1,200人。

据报，杨将军昨日前往南京，旨在与蒋尊簋（Chiangchun Feng，音译）商议，以期宣布独立。

据报，兵工厂第38团的九名士兵因向叛军泄露军事机密，于本月3日被枪决。

您顺从的仆人，

（签名）
总探长。

（签名）
警务处总监。
